quality.review_scope: Independent scientific audit of both complete scanned main pages, all four figures and source-proposed equations passed. SI and cited references remain unreviewed. Presentation refinements pending; no measured-coordinate admission.
missing_fields: Both scanned main pages read visually; no usable embedded text. SI and cited full texts remain unreviewed.
Absolute Al/NH4Cl charges, autoclave capacity, heating ramp, cooling rate, reaction pressure and hot-vessel gas composition are unreported.
Dry glove-box with flowing Ar describes manipulation; it does not establish a pure-Ar atmosphere throughout reaction.
The washing reagent is absolute alcohol with no expanded molecular identity; wash amount/count, vacuum pressure, yield and storage are unreported.
Main 580 °C / 3:1 quantitative size and lattice results are not transferred to lower-ratio or about-500 °C specimens.
No refined atomic coordinates or own functional-property measurements are supplied.
Source-specific molecular, apparatus and particle illustrations remain presentation pending.
